evidence.quote: We propose a $35 million class fund, distributed automatically to the members Brightline can identify from its records. Brightline would separately pay up to $2.5 million in court-approved fees and expenses
Brightline can offer a $31 million class fund plus up to $2 million in court-approved fees and expenses

summary: Plaintiff’s counsel raised fees alongside its initial class-fund proposal. The parties negotiated the fee amount before agreeing on the class fund, but the transcript does not show a fee-for-relief tradeoff or misleading declaration.
